description: These files list every ambulance response made by the White Helmets, the Syria Civil Defence, in Northwest Syria, one row per response. The producer is the White Helmets, whose fleet of about 150 ambulances answers bombings, natural disasters and traffic accidents and works with search and rescue, firefighting and hospitals. Coverage is Northwest Syria from January 2024 to May 2025, in monthly files; the May 2025 file alone holds about 8,500 responses. Each record gives the date, governorate, district, sub-district and community with its humanitarian place code, the type of location served such as a hospital or camp, the operation type such as internal diseases, safe newborn transport or a transfer because no hospital bed was free, and counts of children, men, women, displaced and host community patients. The files are available as free XLSX downloads under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: headers sit below a title row, dates are spreadsheet serial numbers, response times and ambulance positions are not given, and the series stops in May 2025. Simulation uses: calibrating ambulance demand by place and type in a conflict setting, studying transfers caused by full hospitals, and planning fleet size for humanitarian emergency medical services. Related records: the San Francisco fire and EMS calls (data-sf-fire-ems-calls-for-service) give comparable call records in a stable city.
